Different frameworks, the same frozen world
Recorded preference, operative participation and ledger admission are distinct. Admission does not establish the truth of a moral argument.

    
What could change the judgment?
These hinges come from saved argument records. They are attributed model claims, not new facts or independently verified thresholds. An abstention boundary is a recorded condition that would resolve a withheld ranking; it is not the reversal of a preference that was never admitted.

Care, welfare, and obligation in one space

        
The 3D composite interpolates a display-only surface when at least two actions have all three coordinates. Native ledger coordinates and optional Decisions probabilities are labeled for each run. Where jackknife intervals are recorded, they come from ablating one tenth of the packet text at a time; the marker is the jackknife mean. These measure sensitivity to packet omissions, not moral certainty. Missing or refused answers are holes, not zeros. Attractors are occupancy of recorded points. 2D projections are not interpolated.
